description: This file contains unit tests for the ToolResultTextFormatter class, verifying its formatting behavior for plain text, JSON summaries, error messages, and unknown payloads.

classes.name: ToolResultTextFormatterTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test cases for the ToolResultTextFormatter.

methods.name: leavesPlainTextUntouched
methods.description: Tests that plain text remains unchanged after formatting.

methods.name: summarizesNodesListJSON
methods.description: Tests that JSON with nodes is summarized correctly, including node count and properties.

methods.name: summarizesErrorJSONAndDropsAgentPrefix
methods.description: Tests that error JSON is summarized properly, extracting error message.

methods.name: suppressesUnknownStructuredPayload
methods.description: Tests that unknown JSON structures result in an empty format output.
